text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I got some fish mint... Now to mash it all up
before it dries out... Oh, almost
forgot the
healing charm!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Lizard, fish—chameleon! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Without warning, an unbearably pungent
stench starts wafting from
my mouth—so I
spring out of bed!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Oh... you're up.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: You woke uuuuup!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As I pat the back of the small figure
clinging to me, I realize that she
must've
carried me after I collapsed... And then
jammed my mouth full
of fish mint.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Leaving that aside, she may be young, but
she's still an
Umamusume—her grip is
certainly nothing to scoff at. To be honest,

my spine might be at its limit...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Nope! I'm not moving. I don't care if it
hurts. Just deal with it, you
dummy!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Sniff.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! I wasn't worried about you at all!
Actually, I was mad! Super,
duper mad!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
You're my familiar! But then you collapsed!
And gave me a shock! And
wouldn't
answer me!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, are you, like, the world's biggest
dummy?! A familiar should
never, ever,
EVER cause trouble for their magical girl!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...I also made three big bottles of fish mint
tea and squeezed them in
the fridge.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Listen up, okay?! You better drink all of it,
or I won't forgive you!
'Cause I'll be
coming by to check on your progress!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On the surface, Sweep Tosho is trembling
with anger. But at the same
time, I also
feel an equal amount of kindness
underneath.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hmph. As long as you understand, and you
better!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few days pass, and we're back to
training. What selfish whim will
Sweep
demand of me today, I wond—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hey, familiar. Y'know, back when I beat
those two in that race, it felt
really good.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
It was the same when I first met you. I was
tired of being ordered
around, so I tried
ignoring it all and just ran the way I
wanted to...
And it felt kinda good.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
It was nice. It kinda made me feel—I mean,
only a teensy tiny bit—like
this might be
fun.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: It made me realize that running the way I want to run... might be fun.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
And you—you said my running was
magical, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I see... I think I get it now.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you asked me before, didn't you? If I
wanted to see what the
world of racing
truly had to offer?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you asked me before, didn't you? If I
wanted to see what the
world of racing
truly had to offer?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
What did you mean by that? Why do you
think I'll find my magic
there? I wanna
know more, so tell me.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The next weekend, I bring Sweep to Kyoto
Racecourse. The stands
are packed with
spectators impatiently waiting for the start
of a big
race.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Imagine? About what?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The deafening cheers of the fans, feet
speeding over fresh turf—your
rivals are
right there, none of them here to lose. The
race just keeps
on heating up.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Luck, talent, and skill. Even with all three,
victory isn't certain, but
you know this.
Grabbing this once-in-a-lifetime chance,
you burst
across the finish...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Hmmm.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I see. That does sound a teensy bit fun, if
you ask me.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...Hmm.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Okay, I've made up my mind. I'll give
running a try. I'll believe in you.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
To the Twinkle Series we go, in search of
magic!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I mean, if I just keep on running my own
fun way, I might find the
magic I'm looking
for. Right?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I'll trust in my familiar. 'Cause I'm a genius
magical girl with a biiig
heart! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At long last, she's made the decision to
run all by herself! Trying my
best to hold
back tears of joy, I calm myself and
change gears.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's got the makings of a star. From now
on, we'll work hand in hand
and train twice
as hard!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: ...Or at least, that's what I thought.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
First things first—sweets! Today I'm feeling
scones. Grandma ate these
a lot, y'know.
They're perfect for a pick-me-up!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I better see you eating too, okay? Fill up
your tummy so you don't
flop over like last
time.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
After all, you're my familiar—now and
forever! You're gonna be
helping me out
for a looong, long time.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Got it? ...Hey, where's my answer?!
